description: This source file defines a controller class 'BankTransfer' for handling bank transfer payments in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying payment instructions and confirming payment, interacting with order and session data.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for bank transfer payment method, extending the base Opencart Controller, handling payment display and confirmation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, prepares bank transfer instructions based on configuration, and renders the payment view.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the payment confirmation process, validates session and order data, updates order history, and returns a JSON response.
